## 5. Broad Jump with Vertical Jump

Exercise Objective: Develop explosive power, and develop proper landing technique for absorbing large impact forces

## Procedure

1. Stand with feet hip-width apart and toes pointed forward
2. Lower 4 - 6 in. (i.e., countermovement) while bringing both arms back behind the body (-43a)
3. Immediately extend hips, knees, and ankles while driving both arms up and forward, (jumping forward at 45°) (-43b)
4. Bring both legs forward to land with both feet ahead of hips (-43c)
5. Repeat the broad jump (forward jump) three times, and then perform one vertical jump for maximum height (-43d)
